scope: 严重回滚失败草稿兜底与纯文本安全复制
content: HTMLTextAreaElement readOnly property: A boolean that represents the element's readonly attribute, indicating that the user cannot modify the value of the control. value property: A string that represents the raw value contained in the control. select() method: Selects the contents of the control.
conclusion: HTMLTextAreaElement 的 readOnly 属性保证内容不可篡改，value 属性为纯字符串，保留全部换行符与空白字符且不经过 HTML 解析，select() 支持全选文本。可安全用于严重回滚失败时的纯文本草稿复制兜底，不引入 DOM XSS 风险。
